shortDescription: Clean Harbors NYSE:CLH announced the pricing of a private offering of $600M in 6.250% senior notes due 2034.The notes were priced at 100.000% of their aggregate principal amount, with the transaction expected to close on or about October 1, 2026.The company plans to deploy the net proceeds to fund…

children: The notes were priced at 100.000% of their aggregate principal amount, with the transaction expected to close on or about October 1, 2026.

The company plans to deploy the net proceeds to fund the purchase price of its previously announced acquisition of EnviroServe, a national environmental and waste management services provider. Any remaining funds will be used to pay down borrowings under its revolving credit facility that were drawn to partially finance its recent acquisition of ES&H.

Clean Harbors noted that the debt offering is not contingent on the closing of either acquisition. In the event either transaction is not completed on anticipated terms or within the expected timeframe, the company intends to reallocate the remaining net proceeds toward general corporate purposes.

title: Clean Harbors prices $600M private debt offering
